name: prior_mix
value: sources/vendor-mix-notes.md section 2 (bit basis, % of own bits)
reason: No source publishes a vendor x application bit matrix. The researcher built the prior from the vendor-mix.csv rows (SK hynix slides, Micron business units, CXMT prospectus, Nanya call, broker HBM/SOCAMM/GDDR shares). We use it as given, with noise.

name: prior_noise_concentration
reason: Each non-HBM prior cell gets gamma noise with mean = prior and CV = 1/sqrt(k): 10% (strong), 20% (medium), 41% (weak). A plain Dirichlet cannot give cells of one row different precision without moving the mean, so we draw independent gammas and then renormalise the row (the same construction as a Dirichlet when all k are equal).

name: hbm_share_draw
value: per vendor tri(min, median, max) over broker points, then normalised to 1
reason: Brokers disagree (2027: Samsung 39-42%, SK hynix 35-41%). The normalisation absorbs rounding and the China remainder.

name: cxmt_hbm_share
value: the remainder each broker leaves after Samsung, SK hynix and Micron
reason: Daishin's chart leaves ~3% (2026) and ~4% (2027) for China; Samsung Securities, Citi and UBS leave 0-1%. SemiAnalysis: CXMT had 1% of HBM wafers in 2025 at low yield.

name: rows_fixed_shares
value: Mirae Dec 2025 vendor production shares, no noise
reason: Mirae is the only source with bits by vendor for 2025-2027. The shipment-page split is run as a sensitivity instead of as noise.
